test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown in here. Find the number on the face opposite 6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2d26b602fc6e83c6743bdb9d7f2221c346f44ff28da714da3267367cb0eef4a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 3 is common on both the dices II and III, it is clear that 6, 2, 1, and 5 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 4 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/818a378ba1971b3c6bb708d8219c2d989f49afafeb40db24a223c02705e2d5ae.png] 

Opposite pairs:

6 → 1

2 → 5

3 → 4

So, the opposite side of "6" will be side "1".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
